topic: Multan: the city of shrines and blue tiles through the ages

episode.title: Multan Through Time: The Blue-Tile City

shots.scene: Photorealistic cinematic architectural photograph of the Tomb of Shah Rukn-e-Alam in Multan, Pakistan.
